data.body:
**[P2] Enforce the configured size after all truncation phases**

The returned record is never remeasured. A large top-level execution error, which no phase removes, can remain above an exporter's declared limit even after operations and content are dropped; the exporter then fails and `emit()` discards the failure insight. Add a final size check and bounded handling for the error message or other remaining optional fields; if no legal shape fits, skip export with an explicit diagnostic. Cover an oversized execution error in both render shapes.
